evidence.summary: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 WeKnora 知识库检索、文档补读和问答工具。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 packages/dsh-weknora/src/index.ts、packages/dsh-weknora/src/tools.ts、packages/dsh-weknora/package.json、packages/dsh-weknora/src/client.ts、internal/router/routes_chat.go、internal/handler/session/qa.go、internal/application/service/session_knowledge_qa.go、internal/application/service/chat_pipeline/search.go、internal/application/service/knowledgebase_search.go、internal/application/service/knowledgebase_search_results.go、packages/dsh-weknora/README_CN.md；补丁挂载工具注册入口，查询、分页及流式问答均请求外部部署，完整流才返回答案。[Q02](#research-q02)
limitations: 统计仅覆盖 DSH 子包，定向查看与实际请求相连的服务源码。未运行目标、测试、宿主、模型或服务。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 已有 WeKnora 部署的开发者可在 DSH 内核对一条制度并补读来源文档。[Q01](#research-q01)
补丁挂载工具注册入口，查询、分页及流式问答均请求外部部署，完整流才返回答案。[Q02](#research-q02)
统计仅覆盖 DSH 子包，定向查看与实际请求相连的服务源码。未运行目标、测试、宿主、模型或服务。
@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora 0.1.0 声明 dist 作为宿主入口。未核验实际发行 tarball。

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | 部署和依赖资源未测 | 核对索引、权限与包 | 基于已有服务器 |
| 持续 | 检索与模型资源未测 | 复查引用 | 按一条合格答案计 |
| 恢复 | 重试和补读用量未知 | 复查授权与对照网页 | 留意远端会话 |
[Q05](#research-q05) 在隔离配置用受限凭据复核一条规则；越界、引用错误或与网页矛盾时停止并回原文。

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 段落复核 | 返回文档 ID 与片段 | 召回和引文质量 |
| 分页 | 内容裁剪与页码反馈 | 模型会否补读完整 |
| 问答 | 无 complete 报错 | 实际任务综合质量 |
[Q02](#research-q02) 的分页和 SSE 显式完成条件可复用，同时需验证接口版本及服务端诊断稳定性。
[Q01](#research-q01) 把段落、文档补读和服务器综合带进处理同一任务的 Agent，[Q02](#research-q02) 用分页和完整流保留判断依据。
[Q03](#research-q03) 的默认库可以被调用覆盖，真实边界取决于凭据和服务；[Q04](#research-q04) 的服务器变化也会改变客户端拿到的材料。
[Q05](#research-q05) 提议显示可信的检索诊断、有效范围和输出裁剪，让模型决定该补读还是停止。

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DSH 工具契约和 Node | 是 | 加载适配器 | 回原工具 |
| 受限 WeKnora 凭据和服务 | 查询需要 | 获取授权材料 | 核对服务归属及授权 |
| chat 权限及服务端模型 | 仅问答 | 远端综合 | 直接检索并人工归纳 |

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 局部新增现有 API 的宿主适配，算法由服务提供。[Q02](#research-q02) 标题接口降级及完整 SSE 属局部机制改进；可移植的分页和引用类型仍需来源服务支持。普通工具对象将数条路由合在一个适配层，版本和授权仍要维护。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 使当前 Agent 能接续查证，不再需要用户跨应用搬运每段，但交付仍是制度回答，文档标识是局部改善。不熟 API 的用户省去写脚本，仍依赖授权平台。[Q05](#research-q05) 的节约主要是减少手动步骤，远程模型和复查开销未知。

recommendation.reason: 已有 WeKnora 知识库和受限检索凭据的 DSH 开发者，可以在隔离配置中核对一条来源明确的内部部署规范。相比离开当前对话去网页查阅，连接器能直接返回一段原文和文档标识，开发者可继续按页补读。若结果跨出获准范围、引用对不上原文或与同服务网页结果冲突，开发者应停止试用，回到授权网页和原文流程。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的 tools 243–250 行把查段落和后续补读的实际摩擦连起来，超过泛泛查知识的场景。没有用户长期样本，未到最高档。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) tools 329–358 与 401–449 行中的段落至补读路径超出单纯新增入口；[Q04](#research-q04) 的服务器变化需核对，缺合格任务质量改善证据，取中档。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 的 client 369–432 和 [Q04](#research-q04) 的服务端过滤支持完整调用和失败边界，超过只有挂载证据。未运行同版本宿主或服务验证，未到实测档。

cost.rationale: [Q05](#research-q05) 的 README 117–130 行给出启动条件，能退回网页，改善了退出路径未知的情形。但 scope 和引文需复核，ask 留远端状态，不能认定足够轻。

publication.summaries.text: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 WeKnora 知识库检索、文档补读和问答工具。

items.模型工具: 按配置启用列库、段落检索、分块补读和远程问答

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 检索 | 寻找证据段落和文档 | 范围由服务授权决定 |
| 补读 | 分页阅读全文 | 字符上限可裁剪 |
| 问答 | 让 WeKnora 归纳并返回引用 | 要求完整流，可能创建远程会话 |

publication.advice.text: [Q05](#research-q05) 在隔离配置用受限凭据复核一条规则；越界、引用错误或与网页矛盾时停止并回原文。

      "path": "packages/dsh-weknora/README.md",
      "content": "# @wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora\n\nEnglish | [简体中文](./README_CN.md)\n\n[npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora)\n\nA [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin that gives the harness agent\nfirst-class access to a [WeKnora](https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora) knowledge base: hybrid retrieval, full document\nreading, and WeKnora's own composed answers with citations.\n\ndsh ships no retrieval, embedding or knowledge-base capability of its own — its search tools (`grep`, `glob`) read the\nworkspace, and `web_search` reads the internet. This plugin fills that gap with your organization's documents.\n\n## Install\n\n```sh\n# from npm (recommended: installs prebuilt code, no build permission needed)\ndsh plugin --profile web add @wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora\n\n# or from a checkout of this repository\ndsh plugin --profile web add ./packages/dsh-weknora\n```\n\nThen point it at your deployment. The shipped configuration layer reads environment variables, so the quickest start is:\n\n```sh\nexport WEKNORA_BASE_URL=https://weknora.example.com   # or http://localhost:8080\nexport WEKNORA_API_KEY=sk-...                          # a WeKnora API key with `retrieve` (+ `chat` for ask)\nexport WEKNORA_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_IDS=kb-123,kb-456        # optional default scope\nexport WEKNORA_RESOURCE_URLS=public                    # default; `handle` keeps internal file refs\ndsh web\n```\n\nFor anything beyond that, override the row from your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`\n(`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`):\n\n```yaml\n- id: weknora\n  config:\n    baseUrl: https://weknora.example.com\n    apiKey: !!js process.env.WEKNORA_API_KEY\n    knowledgeBaseIds:\n      - kb-product-docs\n    agentId: ''            # a WeKnora custom agent id makes `weknora_ask` use the ReAct pipeline\n    maxResults: 8\n    maxChunkChars: 1200\n    requestTimeoutMs: 30000\n    chatTimeoutMs: 300000\n    resourceUrls: handle   # default is `public` so cited images are directly loadable; `handle` keeps internal refs\n    toolPrefix: weknora    # rename the tools, e.g. to mount two deployments side by side\n    tools:\n      listKnowledgeBases: true\n      search: true\n      readDocument: true\n      ask: true\n```\n\nA patch replaces the row's whole `config`, so restate every field you keep. Invalid configuration fails the plugin load\nwith a message naming each violation, rather than failing inside the first tool call.\n\nMounting two deployments is two rows with two prefixes:\n\n```yaml\n- insert:\n    - id: weknora-internal\n      name: \"@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora\"\n      config: { baseUrl: https://kb.internal.example.com, toolPrefix: internal_kb }\n    - id: weknora-public\n      name: \"@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora\"\n      config: { baseUrl: https://kb.public.example.com, toolPrefix: public_kb }\n```\n\n## Tools\n\n| Tool | WeKnora endpoint | What the model gets |\n|---|---|---|\n| `weknora_list_knowledge_bases` | `GET /knowledge-bases` | Knowledge base names and ids, to report what exists or to narrow a later search |\n| `weknora_search` | `POST /knowledge-search` + `GET /knowledge/search` | Ranked passages verbatim, each with a `knowledge_id`, score and chunk index, plus any document the query names |\n| `weknora_read_document` | `GET /chunks/:knowledge_id` + `GET /knowledge/:id` | One document's passages reassembled in order, led by its title and summary, with paging |\n| `weknora_ask` | `POST /sessions` + `POST /knowledge-chat/:id` or `POST /agent-chat/:id` | WeKnora's own answer, its citations, the server-side tools it used, and a resumable `session_id` |\n\n`weknora_search` is the workhorse: it returns the source text for the agent to reason over, which keeps the agent's own\nreasoning auditable. It answers two questions the model cannot always tell apart — *where is this discussed* and *where\nis the document called X* — by matching passage content and document names in the same call. A query that reads like a\ntitle additionally reports the documents it names, so a document whose wording differs from its own title is still\nreachable.\n\nScope works without configuration. An unscoped call is refused by the retrieval endpoint and answered from nothing by\nthe RAG one, so when `knowledgeBaseIds` is empty the plugin resolves every knowledge base the credential can see and\nuses all of them, resolving that list once per process and sharing it between `weknora_search` and `weknora_ask`.\nMaking the model choose first would be worse: knowledge bases are frequently named too poorly to choose between.\n\n`weknora_ask` delegates the whole question to WeKnora. Reserve it for broad or synthesis questions spanning many\ndocuments, where retrieving passages yourself would take several rounds — it runs another model server-side, so it is\nslow, and it returns a conclusion rather than the evidence behind it. With `agentId` set it leaves the scope alone: a\ncustom agent resolves its own from its KB selection mode, and ids sent from here would override that.\n\n`weknora_read_document` exists because retrieval returns fragments: once a passage looks right, the agent usually needs\nits neighbours. Every search hit carries the `knowledge_id` that call needs, and page 1 leads with the document's title\nand WeKnora's generated summary so a long document can be judged without paging through it.\n\nIn [Code Mode](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/tools/README.md) the same tools\nare available as `await tools.weknora_search({ query })`, which is a good fit for multi-hop retrieval: one program can\nfan out across ten sub-questions without ten model round trips.\n\n## Permissions and data flow\n\nThe plugin only reads. It never writes to WeKnora: no ingestion, no chunk edits, no deletion. A WeKnora API key scoped\nto `retrieve` is enough for three of the four tools; `weknora_ask` additionally needs `chat`, because it creates a\nsession and streams an answer.\n\nThe key is sent as `X-API-Key`. Set `tenantId` as well if you use a platform-scoped key, which needs `X-Tenant-ID` to\nselect a workspace. Errors are reported with the HTTP status and WeKnora's own reason, never with the key.\n\nPassage content is clipped to `maxChunkChars` before it reaches the model, so one oversized document cannot eat the\ncontext window. The clip is reported to the model (`truncated: true`) instead of silently hiding text.\n\nWith the default `resourceUrls: public`, WeKnora rewrites cited `resource://` figures into directly loadable `http(s)`\nURLs. Copy those Markdown images into the assistant reply and the dsh web UI will render the picture. A\nknowledge-base-restricted API key cannot receive public URLs (WeKnora answers 403); the plugin retries that call in\nhandle mode and keeps using handles afterwards.\n\nThe shipped configuration layer also reads `WEKNORA_RESOURCE_URLS` (`public` or `handle`).\n\n## Configuration reference\n\n| Field | Default | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:8080/api/v1` | `/api/v1` is appended when missing |\n| `apiKey` | unset | `X-API-Key`; unset means an unauthenticated deployment |\n| `tenantId` | unset | `X-Tenant-ID`, required for platform-scoped keys |\n| `knowledgeBaseIds` | `[]` | Default scope when a call names none; empty means every knowledge base the credential can see |\n| `agentId` | unset | Sends `weknora_ask` to the ReAct pipeline |\n| `maxResults` | `8` | Also the ceiling for `max_results` and for cited references |\n| `maxChunkChars` | `1200` | Per-passage character budget |\n| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Retrieval and document reads |\n| `chatTimeoutMs` | `300000` | `weknora_ask`, which waits on WeKnora's own model calls |\n| `resourceUrls` | `public` | `public` returns directly loadable file URLs; `handle` keeps internal `resource://` refs. A knowledge-base-restricted API key is retried as `handle`. Override with `WEKNORA_RESOURCE_URLS`. |\n| `toolPrefix` | `weknora` | Tool-name prefix, `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$` |\n| `tools.*` | all `true` | Register fewer tools to spend fewer prompt tokens |\n\n## Development\n\n```sh\nnpm install\nnpm test          # builds, then runs the unit and contract tests\nnpm run typecheck\n```\n\nThe end-to-end check installs the package into a throwaway dsh profile, boots the headless profile against a mock\nWeKnora backend and a deterministic OpenAI-compatible model, and asserts that the harness really called the tools and\nanswered from what they returned:\n\n```sh\nnpm run build\nnode test/e2e/run-in-dsh.mjs                        # installs dsh from npm on first run\nDSH_BIN=/path/to/dsh node test/e2e/run-in-dsh.mjs   # or reuse an existing install\n```\n\ndsh needs a Node build with zstd support (Node ≥ 22.15 or ≥ 24) for its session persistence, and pnpm ≥ 10 on `PATH`,\nbecause `dsh plugin add` installs into the profile through pnpm and the profile it writes keeps its settings in\n`pnpm-workspace.yaml`. The plugin itself runs on Node ≥ 20.11 and needs neither.\n\n`test/fixtures/api-contract.json` records every WeKnora call this plugin makes. `test/contract.test.mjs` asserts the\nplugin still emits exactly those calls, and `contract/contract_test.go` asserts WeKnora's real Go request and response\ntypes still accept and serve them — so a rename on either side fails CI instead of a user's agent.\n\n## Compatibility\n\nVerified against dsh `0.1.0-rc.8` and WeKnora `0.8.0`. dsh is in developer preview and states that breaking changes\nwill happen; this package deliberately has **no runtime dependencies** and hands `ctx.tools.register()` a plain object,\nso it does not pin any harness package version. If a harness release changes the tool-definition contract, open an issue\nagainst this repository.\n\n## License\n\nMIT, same as WeKnora and dsh.\n"

src=\"https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Tencent/WeKnora?style=flat-square&labelColor=101f38&color=b8863b\"></a>\n  <br/>\n  <a href=\"https://chatbot.weixin.qq.com\"><img alt=\"WeChat Dialog Open src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/Chrome-extension-4285f4?style=flat-square&labelColor=101f38&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white\"></a>\n  <a href=\"https://clawhub.ai/lyingbug/weknora\"><img alt=\"ClawHub Skill\" src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/ClawHub-skill-ff6b35?style=flat-square&labelColor=101f38\"></a>\n  <a href=\"https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora\"><img src=\"https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora?style=flat-square&label=dsh-weknora&labelColor=101f38&color=cb3837&logo=npm&logoColor=white\"></a>\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <b>English</b> · <a href=\"./README_CN.md\">简体中文</a> · <a href=\"./README_JA.md\">日本語</a> · <a href=\"./README_KO.md\">한국어</a>\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <a href=\"#overview\">Overview</a> ·\n href=\"#documentation\">Docs</a> ·\n  <a href=\"#development\">Development</a>\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <a href=\"https://trendshift.io/repositories/15289\"><img src=\"https://trendshift.io/api/badge/repositories/15289\" alt=\"Tencent/WeKnora | Trendshift\" width=\"220\" height=\"48\"/></a>\n</p>\n\n## Overview\n\n[WeKnora](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com) is an open-source, LLM-powered knowledge framework for enterprise document understanding, semantic retrieval and reasoning. It brings a team's documents together so they can be searched, reasoned over and kept up to date.\n\nhttps://github.com/user-attachments/assets/de0e490a-e738-405e-bb3a-64b63edd7278\n\n<p align=\"center\"><sub>v0.9.0 · 2:45 · 1080p60 · English narration and subtitles</sub></p>\n\nUse RAG to look things up, the agent for multi-step tasks, and the wiki to organize knowledge. All three work on the same knowledge bases.\n\n<picture>\n  <source media=\"(prefers-color-scheme: dark)\" srcset=\"./docs/images/readme/capabilities-en-dark.svg\">\n  <img src=\"./docs/images/readme/capabilities-en-light.svg\" alt=\"01 RAG: answers you can check, with hybrid search, multimodal parsing and citations. 02 Agent: tasks done with knowledge and tools, with multi-step reasoning, skills and sandbox, the local browser, MCP tools and memory. 03 Wiki: documents organized into a wiki, with a knowledge graph and rollback.\" width=\"100%\">\n</picture>\n\n**The agent's toolbox.** Skills installed from ClawHub / SkillHub / Git / ZIP run in session-persistent Docker / E2B / Cube sandboxes, with an interactive terminal and graphical desktop beside the chat. Through the BrowserSkill extension the agent operates the user's own Chrome or Edge, and external MCP services (OAuth included) can be connected and enabled tool by tool.\n\nBeyond the three modes:\n\n- **Memory and curation**: cross-session long-term memory keeps the profile, preferences and facts a user has confirmed. Folder uploads keep their directory tree, and retrieval chunks can be edited, diffed and rolled back.\n- **Data sources and formats**: auto-sync from Feishu wiki / Feishu Drive / Confluence / GitLab / Tencent IMA / Notion / Yuque / DingTalk Docs / Seafile / RSS, with more on the way. 10+ document formats including PDF, Word, images, Excel and XMind; Office files are parsed in-process by anydoc.\n- **Channels and integrations**: Q&A in WeCom, Feishu, Slack, Telegram and other IM apps; an embed widget for external websites; a built-in MCP Server for Cursor, Claude and other AI tools; scoped API keys with a principal model for programmatic access.\n- **Models**: 29 built-in vendors with a generated model catalog, including OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen (Alibaba Cloud), Zhipu, Hunyuan, Gemini, MiniMax, NVIDIA, LiteLLM and Ollama.\n- **Permissions and operations**: multi-workspace RBAC (four roles, per-resource ownership, per-workspace audit log), several storage instances per workspace, a runtime task-queue dashboard with worker-pool governance, and Langfuse tracing for agent steps, token usage and pipelines.\n- **Deployment**: LLMs, vector databases and storage backends are all swappable. Deploy locally or on a private cloud and keep the data in your own environment.\n\n## Quick Start\n\n<table>\n  <tr>\n    <td width=\"33%\" valign=\"top\">\n      <img src=\"./website-docs/homepage/public/docs/_home/brands/wechat-dialog.png\" width=\"28\" height=\"28\" alt=\"\"><br/>\n      <sub>ONLINE</sub><br/>\n      <b>WeChat Dialog Open Platform</b><br/>\n      Manage knowledge bases online and connect Q&A to Official Accounts, Mini Programs and other WeChat scenarios.<br/><br/>\n      <a href=\"https://chatbot.weixin.qq.com/login\">Open the platform →</a>\n    </td>\n    <td width=\"33%\" valign=\"top\">\n      <img src=\"./website-docs/homepage/public/docs/_home/brands/tencent-cloud.ico\" width=\"28\" height=\"28\" alt=\"\"><br/>\n      <sub>CLOUD</sub><br/>\n      <b>Tencent Cloud Lighthouse</b><br/>\n      Deploy WeKnora from an application template and run it on your own cloud server.<br/><br/>\n      <a href=\"https://mc.tencent.com/s69nKCVz\">Deploy on Tencent Cloud →</a>\n    </td>\n    <td width=\"33%\" valign=\"top\">\n      <img src=\"./docs/images/readme/icons/server.svg\" width=\"28\" height=\"28\" alt=\"\"><br/>\n      <sub>SELF-HOSTED</sub><br/>\n      <b>Your own environment</b><br/>\n      Deploy with Docker or Kubernetes and configure models, storage and networking yourself.<br/><br/>\n      <a href=\"#run-with-docker-compose\">Run with Docker Compose ↓</a>\n    </td>\n  </tr>\n</table>\n\n### Run with Docker Compose\n\nRequires [Docker](https://www.docker.com/), [Docker Compose](https://docs.docker.com/compose/) and [Git](https://git-scm.com/).\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora.git\ncd WeKnora\ncp .env.example .env    # Edit .env as needed, see comments in the file\ndocker compose pull     # Pull the latest images\ndocker compose up -d    # Start core services\n```\n\nThen open **http://localhost** and follow the onboarding guide. A walkthrough with sample data is in the [Quickstart](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/01-getting-started/03-quickstart).\n\n> [!TIP]\n> To use a local Ollama model, run `ollama serve > /dev/null 2>&1 &` first. For the Ollama embedding model name, `OLLAMA_BASE_URL`, and RAM notes, see [Configuration](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/01-getting-started/04-configuration).\n\n| Service | URL |\n|---------|-----|\n| Web UI | `http://localhost` |\n| Backend API | `http://localhost:8080` |\n| Langfuse Tracing | `http://localhost:3000` |\n\n### Optional services\n\nAdd `--profile` flags to enable additional components; multiple profiles can be combined.\n\n| Profile | Adds |\n|---------|------|\n| _(default)_ | Core services |\n| `full` | All features |\n| `neo4j` | Knowledge Graph (Neo4j) |\n| `minio` | Object Storage (MinIO) |\n| `langfuse` | Tracing (Langfuse) |\n\n```bash\ndocker compose --profile neo4j --profile minio pull\ndocker compose --profile neo4j --profile minio up -d\ndocker compose down     # Stop services\n```\n\n### Upgrading\n\nIf you already have WeKnora running and downloaded a newer release:\n\n```bash\n# Set WEKNORA_VERSION in .env to the target release (e.g. 0.9.0), or keep latest\ndocker compose pull     # Pull images matching WEKNORA_VERSION\ndocker compose up -d    # Recreate containers with new images\n```\n\n> [!NOTE]\n> `docker compose up -d` alone reuses locally cached images and may leave the UI version out of sync with the release you downloaded. Read the [upgrade notes](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.9.0#upgrade-notes) before upgrading. Deployments older than v0.8.2 should also read the [v0.8.2 notes](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/07-releases/v0.8.2#upgrade-notes).\n\n### Other ways to deploy\n\n| Option | When to use it |\n|--------|----------------|\n| **Docker Compose** | The standard deployment above: all features, multiple services |\n| **Kubernetes (Helm)** | Production clusters; the chart is in [`helm/`](./helm) |\n| **Lite single binary** | Local or low-resource use with no external dependencies (SQLite + in-memory queue); see [Lite vs. standard](./docs/LITE.md) |\n| **Desktop app** | The Lite runtime with a GUI, login-free start and a macOS host sandbox; no installer is published yet, so build it from source |\n\nAll options, hardware requirements and deployment topologies: [Installation guide](https://weknora.weixin.qq.com/docs/01-getting-started/02-installation).\n\n> [!WARNING]\n> WeKnora ships with login authentication, but for production deployments we strongly recommend that you:\n> - deploy it in an internal / private network rather than on the public internet;\n> - avoid exposing the service directly to public networks, to prevent information leakage;\n> - configure proper firewall rules and access controls for the deployment environment;\n> - regularly update to the latest version for security patches and improvements.\n\n## What's New\n\n### v0.9.0 about WeKnora releases, features and configuration, then work from the current page: create agents, schedule tasks and manage knowledge, acting as you within your permissions.\n- **[Multi-agent WeKnora: upload knowledge and publish a Q&A service in WeChat without writing code |\n\n### Command-Line Interface\n\n`weknora` is the official CLI for driving the API from a terminal or an AI agent. It is **agent-first**: every command emits a stable JSON envelope by default (with typed error codes mapped to exit codes), and `--format text` renders for humans. It also serves a curated MCP tool surface (`weknora mcp serve`) and ships bundled Agent Skills.\n\n```bash\nweknora profile add prod --host https://kb.example.com --use\nweknora auth login\nweknora kb list\nweknora link --kb my-knowledge-base    # bind the current directory\nweknora doc upload notes.md\nweknora chat \"summarise the design doc\"\n```\n\nFor headless / CI use, set `WEKNORA_API_KEY` + `WEKNORA_HOST` and skip `auth login`; no credentials are written to disk. See the directory's README for Nginx and Docker deployment.\n\n## Contributing\n\nWelcome to submit [Issues](https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora/issues) or Pull Requests.\n\n- **Process:** Fork → Create branch → Commit changes → Open PR\n- **Standards:** Format code with `gofmt`, follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:` / `fix:` / `docs:` / `test:` / `refactor:`)\n\n<details>\n<summary><b>Validating your change</b></summary>\n\n<br/>\n\nFor a focused PR, validate the changed scope first:\n\n```bash\ngit fetch origin main\ngit diff --check origin/main...HEAD\ngolangci-lint run --new-from-rev=origin/main ./...\ngo test ./path/to/changed/package -count=1\n```\n\nRun `gofmt` on changed Go files before committing. ctxErr != nil {\n\t\t\tcommon.PipelineWarn(ctx, \"Pipeline\", \"stage_cancelled\", map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\t\"event\":       string(eventType),\n\t\t\t\t\"duration_ms\": stageDuration.Milliseconds(),\n\t\t\t\t\"reason\":      ctxErr.Error(),\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\treturn ctxErr\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err == chatpipeline.ErrSearchNothing {\n\t\t\tcommon.PipelineWarn(ctx, \"Pipeline\", \"stage_fallback\", map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\t\"event\":       string(eventType),\n\t\t\t\t\"duration_ms\": stageDuration.Milliseconds(),\n\t\t\t\t\"reason\":      \"search_nothing\",\n\t\t\t\t\"strategy\":    string(chatManage.FallbackStrategy),\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\ts.handleFallbackResponse(ctx, chatManage)\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tcommon.PipelineError(ctx, \"Pipeline\", \"stage_failed\", map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\t\"event\":       string(eventType),\n\t\t\t\t\"duration_ms\": stageDuration.Milliseconds(),\n\t\t\t\t\"error_type\":  err.ErrorType,\n\t\t\t\t\"description\": err.Description,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\treturn err.Err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcommon.PipelineInfo(ctx, \"Pipeline\", \"stage_complete\", map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"event\":       string(eventType),\n\t\t\t\"duration_ms\": stageDuration.Milliseconds(),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\tcommon.PipelineInfo(ctx, \"Pipeline\", \"all_stages_complete\", map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\"session_id\":        chatManage.SessionID,\n\t\t\"total_stages\":      len(eventList),\n\t\t\"total_duration_ms\": time.Since(pipelineStart).Milliseconds(),\n\t})\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// SearchKnowledge performs knowledge base search without LLM summarization\n// knowledgeBaseIDs: list of knowledge base IDs to search (supports multi-KB)\n// knowledgeIDs: list of specific knowledge (file) IDs to search\n// opts: caller overrides of the tenant RetrievalConfig; nil keeps it\nfunc (s *sessionService) SearchKnowledge(ctx context.Context,\n\tknowledgeBaseIDs []string, knowledgeIDs []string, tagScopes []types.TagScope, query string,\n\topts *types.KnowledgeSearchOptions,\n) (*types.RetrievalResult, error) {\n\tlogger.Info(ctx, \"Start knowledge base search without LLM summary\")\n\tlogger.Infof(ctx, \"Knowledge base search parameters, knowledge base IDs: %v, knowledge IDs: %v, tag scopes: %d, query: %s\",\n\t\tknowledgeBaseIDs, knowledgeIDs, len(tagScopes), query)\n\tif opts == nil {\n\t\topts = &types.KnowledgeSearchOptions{}\n\t}\n\tif opts.DisableVectorMatch && opts.DisableKeywordsMatch {\n\t\treturn nil, apperrors.NewBadRequestError(\"disable_vector_match and disable_keywords_match cannot both be true\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Get tenant ID from context\n\ttenantID, ok := types.TenantIDFromContext(ctx)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tlogger.Error(ctx, \"Failed to get tenant ID from context\")\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"workspace ID not found in context\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Load tenant-level retrieval config (nil is safe — GetEffective* methods handle nil receiver)\n\tvar rc *types.RetrievalConfig\n\tif tenant, err2 := s.tenantService.GetTenantByID(ctx, tenantID); No rerank object means \"rerank with the tenant config\", which\n\t// is what this endpoint has always done.\n\trerankDisabled := opts.Rerank != nil && !opts.Rerank.IsEnabled()\n\tvar rerankModelID, rerankModelSource string\n\tif !rerankDisabled {\n\t\trequested := \"\"\n\t\tif opts.Rerank != nil {\n\t\t\trequested = opts.Rerank.ModelID\n\t\t}\n\t\tvar err error\n\t\trerankModelID, rerankModelSource, err = resolveRerankModelID(ctx, s.modelService, requested, rc)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// A model that cannot be loaded degrades to the retrieval s.modelService.GetRerankModel(ctx, rerankModelID); err != nil {\n\t\t\tlogger.Warnf(ctx, \"Rerank model %s unavailable, searching without rerank: %v\", rerankModelID, err)\n\t\t\tunavailable = \"\"\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Build unified search targets (computed once, used throughout pipeline)\n\tsearchTargets, err := s.buildSearchTargets(ctx, tenantID, knowledgeBaseIDs, knowledgeIDs, tagScopes)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"build search targets: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tchatManage := &types.ChatManage{\n\t\tPipelineRequest: types.PipelineRequest{\n\t\t\tQuery:                query,\n\t\t\tUserID:               types.SessionOwnerIDFromContext(ctx),\n\t\t\tKnowledgeBaseIDs:     knowledgeBaseIDs,\n\t\t\tKnowledgeIDs:         knowledgeIDs,\n\t\t\tSearchTargets:        searchTargets,\n\t\t\tMaxRounds:            s.cfg.Conversation.MaxRounds,\n\t\t\tEmbeddingTopK:        rc.GetEffectiveEmbeddingTopK(),\n\t\t\tVectorThreshold:      rc.GetEffectiveVectorThreshold(),\n\t\t\tKeywordThreshold:     rc.GetEffectiveKeywordThreshold(),\n\t\t\tDisableVectorMatch:   opts.DisableVectorMatch,\n\t\t\tDisableKeywordsMatch: opts.DisableKeywordsMatch,\n\t\t\tQueryImage:           opts.QueryImage,\n\t\t\tQueryImageMediaType:  opts.QueryImageMediaType,\n\t\t\tRerankModelID:        rerankModelID,\n\t\t\tRerankTopK:           rc.GetEffectiveRerankTopK(),\n\t\t\tRerankThreshold:      rc.GetEffectiveRerankThreshold(),\n\t\t},\n\t\tPipelineState: types.PipelineState{\n\t\t\tRewriteQuery: query,\n\t\t},\n\t}\n\tapplyKnowledgeSearchOverrides(chatManage, opts)\n\n\tresults, err := s.runKnowledgeSearchPipeline(ctx, chatManage, len(searchTargets))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tdiag := chatManage.RerankDiagnostics\n\tswitch {\n\tcase rerankDisabled:\n\t\tdiag = &types.RerankDiagnostics{Outcome: types.RerankOutcomeDisabled}\n\tcase unavailable != nil:\n\t\tdiag = unavailable\n\t\tdiag.Threshold, diag.EffectiveThreshold = chatManage.RerankThreshold, chatManage.RerankThreshold\n\tcase diag == nil:\n\t\t// Retrieval found nothing, so the rerank stage never ran.\n\t\tdiag = &types.RerankDiagnostics{\n\t\t\tOutcome:            types.RerankOutcomeNoCandidates,\n\t\t\tModelID:            rerankModelID,\n\t\t\tThreshold:          chatManage.RerankThreshold,\n\t\t\tEffectiveThreshold: chatManage.RerankThreshold,\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tdiag.ModelSource = rerankModelSource\n\tif rerankDisabled {\n\t\tdiag.ModelSource = \"\"\n\t}\n\tif rerankDisabled || unavailable != nil {\n\t\t// The rerank stage did not run; the results are the retrieval order.\n\t\tdiag.CandidateCount = len(results)\n\t}\n\tdiag.ResultCount = opts.KeywordThreshold != nil {\n\t\tchatManage.KeywordThreshold = *opts.KeywordThreshold\n\t}\n\tchatManage.ParentSlotAggregation = opts.ParentSlotAggregation\n\t// The final FILTER_TOP_K stage cuts An empty search or an all-rejecting rerank is\n// an empty result, not an error.\nfunc (s *sessionService) runKnowledgeSearchPipeline(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tchatManage *types.ChatManage,\n\ttargetCount int,\n) ([]*types.SearchResult, error) {\n\tif targetCount == 0 {\n\t\tlogger.Warn(ctx, \"No search targets available, returning empty results\")\n\t\treturn []*types.SearchResult{}, nil\n\t}\n\n\t// Use specific event list, only including retrieval-related events, not LLM summarization\n\tsearchEvents := []types.EventType{\n\t\ttypes.CHUNK_SEARCH, // Vector search\n\t\ttypes.CHUNK_RERANK, // Rerank search results\n\t\ttypes.CHUNK_MERGE,  // Merge search results\n\t\ttypes.FILTER_TOP_K, // Filter top K results\n\t}\n\n\tlogger.Infof(ctx, \"Trigger search event list: %v\", searchEvents)\n\n\tfor _, event := range searchEvents {\n\t\tlogger.Infof(ctx, \"Starting to trigger search event: %v\", event)\n\t\tstageCtx, stageSpan := langfuse.GetManager().StartSpan(ctx, langfuse.SpanOptions{\n\t\t\tName: \"pipeline.\" + string(event),\n\t\t\tMetadata: map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\t\"event_type\": string(event),\n\t\t\t\t\"flow\":       \"search_knowledge\",\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t})\n\t\terr := s.eventManager.Trigger(stageCtx, event, chatManage)\n\t\tvar spanErr error\n\t\tif err != nil && err != chatpipeline.ErrSearchNothing {\n\t\t\tspanErr = err.Err\n\t\t}\n\t\tstageSpan.Finish(nil, nil, spanErr)\n\n\t\tif err == chatpipeline.ErrSearchNothing {\n\t\t\tlogger.Warnf(ctx, \"Event %v triggered, search result is empty\", event)\n\t\t\treturn []*types.SearchResult{}, nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlogger.Errorf(ctx, \"Event triggering failed, event: %v, error type: %s, description: chatManage.MergeResult, nil\n}\n\n// handleFallbackResponse handles fallback response based on strategy\nfunc (s *sessionService) handleFallbackResponse(ctx context.Context, chatManage chatManage)\n\t}\n}\n\n// handleFixedFallback handles fixed fallback response\nfunc (s *sessionService) handleFixedFallback(ctx context.Context, chatManage *types.ChatManage) {\n\tfallbackContent := model-based fallback response using streaming\nfunc (s *sessionService) handleModelFallback(ctx context.Context, chatManage *types.ChatManage) {\n\t// Check if FallbackPrompt is available\n\tif chatManage.FallbackPrompt == \"\" {\n\t\tlogger.Warnf(ctx, \"Fallback strategy is 'model' but FallbackPrompt is empty, falling back to fixed response\")\n\t\ts.handleFixedFallback(ctx, chatManage)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Render template with Query variable\n\tpromptContent, err := s.renderFallbackPrompt(ctx, chatManage)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlogger.Errorf(ctx, \"Failed to render == nil {\n\t\tlogger.Warnf(ctx, \"EventBus not available for streaming fallback, falling back to fixed response\")\n\t\ts.handleFixedFallback(ctx, chatManage)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Get chat model\n\tchatModel, err := s.modelService.GetChatModel(chatManage.ChatModelContext(ctx), chatManage.ChatModelID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlogger.Errorf(ctx, \"Failed to get chat model for fallback: %v, falling back to fixed response\", err)\n\t\ts.handleFixedFallback(ctx, chatManage)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Prepare chat options\n\tthinking := false\n\topt := &chat.ChatOptions{\n\t\tTemperature: response\n\tfallbackMessages, modelContext := prepareFallbackMessages(chatManage, promptContent)\n\tif leaks := modelContext.LeakedIdentifiers(fallbackMessages); len(leaks) > 0 {\n\t\tlogger.Warnf(ctx, \"[Fallback][ModelContext] %d message field(s) carry raw identifiers after encoding: %s\",\n\t\t\tlen(leaks), modelcontext.SummarizeLeaks(leaks))\n\t}\n\tresponseChan, err := chatModel.ChatStream(ctx, fallbackMessages, opt)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlogger.Errorf(ctx, \"Failed to start streaming fallback response: %v, falling back to fixed response\", err)\n\t\ts.handleFixedFallback(ctx, chatManage)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tif responseChan == nil {\n\t\tlogger.Errorf(ctx, \"Chat stream returned nil channel, falling back to fixed response\")\n\t\ts.handleFixedFallback(ctx, chatManage)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Start goroutine to consume stream and emit events\n\tgo s.consumeFallbackStream(ctx, chatManage, responseChan, modelContext)\n}\n\nfunc prepareFallbackMessages(\n\tchatManage *types.ChatManage,\n\tpromptContent string,\n) ([]chat.Message, *modelcontext.Registry) {\n\tmessages := buildFallbackMessages(chatManage, promptContent)\n\tcitationsEnabled := chatManage == nil || chatManage.CitationsEnabled()\n\tregistry := modelcontext.NewRegistry(citationsEnabled)\n\tif len(messages) > 0 && messages[0].Role == \"system\" {\n\t\tmessages[0].Content = strings.TrimRight(messages[0].Content, \" \\t\\r\\n\") + registry.ProtocolPrompt()\n\t} else {\n\t\tmessages = append([]chat.Message{{Role: \"system\", Content: strings.TrimSpace(registry.ProtocolPrompt())}}, messages...)\n\t}\n\treturn registry.EncodeMessages(messages), registry\n}\n\nfunc buildFallbackMessages(chatManage *types.ChatManage, promptContent string) []chat.Message {\n\tmessages := make([]chat.Message, 0, len(chatManage.History)*2+2)\n\n\t// The model-fallback prompt is a system-style instruction (KB document\n\t// listing + \"use general knowledge when nothing matched\" guidance). We deliberately do NOT reuse\n\t// the RAG summary system prompt (SummaryConfig.Prompt) here: that template\n\t// forbids prior knowledge (\"reply ONLY based on retrieved information\"),\n\t// which directly contradicts the fallback's purpose.\n\tif strings.TrimSpace(promptContent) != \"\" {\n\t\tmessages = append(messages, chat.Message{\n\t\t\tRole: \"system\",\n\t\t\tContent: promptContent + \"\\n\\n\" + types.SourceDataBoundaryPrompt +\n\t\t\t\t\"\\n\\n\" + types.SourcedAnswerOutputPrompt,\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\tmessages = chatpipeline.AppendHistoryMessages(messages, chatManage.History)\n\n\t// End on the user's actual question so generation is prompted by a user\n\t// turn (the query is also embedded in the system instruction above, but a\n\t// trailing user message keeps the chat shape valid for all providers).\n\tquery := chatManage.Query\n\tif rq := strings.TrimSpace(chatManage.RewriteQuery); rq != \"\" {\n\t\tquery = rq\n\t}\n\tuserMsg := chat.Message{Role: \"user\", Content: query}\n\tif chatManage.ChatModelSupportsVision && len(chatManage.Images) > 0 {\n\t\tuserMsg.Images = chatManage.Images\n\t}\n\n\treturn append(messages, userMsg)\n}\n\n// renderFallbackPrompt renders the fallback prompt template with query and image context.\nfunc (s *sessionService) renderFallbackPrompt(ctx context.Context, chatManage *types.ChatManage) (string, error) {\n\tquery := chatManage.Query\n\tif rq := strings.TrimSpace(chatManage.RewriteQuery); rq != \"\" {\n\t\tquery = rq\n\t}\n\n\tkbDocuments := s.buildKBDocumentListing(ctx, chatManage)\n\n\tresult := types.RenderPromptPlaceholders(chatManage.FallbackPrompt, types.PlaceholderValues{\n\t\t\"query\":        query,\n\t\t\"language\":     chatManage.Language,\n\t\t\"kb_documents\": kbDocuments,\n\t})\n\n\tif chatManage.ImageDescription != \"\" && !chatManage.ChatModelSupportsVision {\n\t\tresult += \"\\n\\n[用户上传图片内容]\\n\" + chatManage.ImageDescription\n\t}\n\tif chatManage.QuotedContext != \"\" {\n\t\tresult += \"\\n\\n\" + chatManage.QuotedContext\n\t}\n\treturn result, nil\n}\n\n// buildKBDocumentListing returns a concise listing of documents in the knowledge bases\n// associated with the current pipeline. This gives the LLM visibility into KB contents\n// when vector/keyword search returns empty (e.g., broad browse queries).\nfunc (s *sessionService) buildKBDocumentListing(ctx context.Context, chatManage *types.ChatManage) string {\n\t// Collect unique KB IDs from search targets\n\tkbIDs := make(map[string]struct{})\n\tfor _, t := range chatManage.SearchTargets {\n\t\tkbIDs[t.KnowledgeBaseID] = struct{}{}\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range chatManage.KnowledgeBaseIDs {\n\t\tkbIDs[id] = struct{}{}\n\t}\n\tif len(kbIDs) == 0 {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\n\tconst maxDocuments = 50\n\tvar b strings.Builder\n\ttotal := 0\n\n\tfor kbID := range kbIDs {\n\t\tif total >= maxDocuments {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\tknowledges, err := s.knowledgeService.ListKnowledgeByKnowledgeBaseID(ctx, kbID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlogger.Warnf(ctx, \"buildKBDocumentListing: failed to list knowledge for KB %s: %v\", kbID, err)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, k := range knowledges {\n\t\t\tif total >= maxDocuments {\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif k.EnableStatus != \"enabled\" {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\ttitle := k.Title\n\t\t\tif title == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\ttitle = k.FileName\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif title == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(&b, \"- %s\", title)\n\t\t\tif k.FileType != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(&b, \" (%s)\", k.FileType)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif k.Description != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tdesc := k.Description\n\t\t\t\tif len([]rune(desc)) > 100 {\n\t\t\t\t\tdesc = string([]rune(desc)[:100]) + \"...\"\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(&b, \": %s\", desc)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tb.WriteString(\"\\n\")\n\t\t\ttotal++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif b.Len() == 0 {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\n\tif total >= maxDocuments {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(&b, \"... (showing first %d documents)\\n\", maxDocuments)\n\t}\n\n\treturn b.String()\n}\n\n// consumeFallbackStream consumes the streaming response and emits events\nfunc (s *sessionService) consumeFallbackStream(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tchatManage *types.ChatManage,\n\tresponseChan <-chan types.StreamResponse,\n\tmodelContext *modelcontext.Registry,\n) {\n\tfallbackID := generateEventID(\"fallback\")\n\teventBus := chatManage.EventBus\n\tvar finalContent string\n\tstreamCompleted := false\n\tdecoder := modelContext.StreamDecoder()\n\n\tfor response := range responseChan {\n\t\t// Emit event for each answer chunk\n\t\tif response.ResponseType == types.ResponseTypeAnswer {\n\t\t\tresponse.Content = decoder.Feed(response.Content)\n\t\t\tif response.Done {\n\t\t\t\tresponse.Content += decoder.Flush()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\ttruncated := response.Done && chatpipeline.IsLengthFinishReason(response.FinishReason)\n\t\t\tif truncated && strings.TrimSpace(finalContent+response.Content) == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tresponse.Content = chatpipeline.EmptyTruncatedAnswerFallback\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfinalContent += response.Content\n\t\t\tif err := eventBus.Emit(ctx, types.Event{\n\t\t\t\tID:        fallbackID,\n\t\t\t\tType:      types.EventType(event.EventAgentFinalAnswer),\n\t\t\t\tSessionID: chatManage.SessionID,\n\t\t\t\tData: event.AgentFinalAnswerData{\n\t\t\t\t\tContent:    response.Content,\n\t\t\t\t\tDone:       response.Done,\n\t\t\t\t\tIsFallback: true,\n\t\t\t\t\tTruncated:  truncated,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t}); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tlogger.Errorf(ctx, \"Failed to emit fallback answer chunk event: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// Update ChatResponse with final content when done\n\t\t\tif response.Done {\n\t\t\t\tchatManage.ChatResponse = &types.ChatResponse{Content: finalContent}\n\t\t\t\tstreamCompleted = true\n\t\t\t\tlogger.Infof(ctx, \"Fallback streaming response completed\")\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// If channel closed without Done=true, emit final event with fixed response\n\tif !streamCompleted {\n\t\tlogger.Warnf(ctx, \"Fallback stream closed without completion, emitting final event with fixed response\")\n\t\ts.emitFallbackAnswer(ctx, chatManage, chatManage.FallbackResponse)\n\t}\n}\n\n// emitKnowledgeReferencesEvent streams retrieved chunks to the client as a\n// `references` SSE event. err != nil {\n\t\tlogger.Errorf(ctx, \"Failed to emit references event: %v\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\n// emitFallbackAnswer emits fallback answer event\nfunc (s *sessionService) emitFallbackAnswer(ctx context.Context, chatManage *types.ChatManage, content string) {\n\tif chatManage.EventBus == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif !chatManage.CitationsEnabled() {\n\t\tcontent = modelcontext.NewRegistry(false).DecodeOutputText(content)\n\t}\n\n\tfallbackID := generateEventID(\"fallback\")\n\tif err := chatManage.EventBus.Emit(ctx, types.Event{\n\t\tID:        fallbackID,\n\t\tType:      types.EventType(event.EventAgentFinalAnswer),\n\t\tSessionID: chatManage.SessionID,\n\t\tData: event.AgentFinalAnswerData{\n\t\t\tContent:    content,\n\t\t\tDone:       true,\n\t\t\tIsFallback: true,\n\t\t},\n\t}); Agent-level override\n\tif req.CustomAgent != nil && req.CustomAgent.Config.WebSearchProviderID != \"\" {\n\t\treturn req.CustomAgent.Config.WebSearchProviderID\n\t}\n\t// 2.  chatManage.TenantID,\n\t\t\"web_enabled\":    chatManage.WebSearchEnabled,\n\t})\n\n\t// Run KB search and web search concurrently\n\tpipelineInfo(ctx, \"Search\", \"plan\", chatManage.VectorThreshold,\n\t\t\"keyword_threshold\": chatManage.KeywordThreshold,\n\t})\n\tvar wg sync.WaitGroup\n\tvar mu sync.Mutex\n\tallResults := make([]*types.SearchResult, 0)\n\tvar webResults...)\n\t\t\tmu.Unlock()\n\t\t}\n\t}()\n\n\twg.Wait()\n\tif kbSearchErr != nil && len(allResults) == 0 {\n\t\tpipelineError(ctx, \"Search\", \"kb_search_failed\", results\n\tif len(chatManage.SearchResult) != 0 {\n\t\tpipelineInfo(ctx, \"Search\", \"output\", map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"session_id\":   chatManage.SessionID,\n\t\t\t\"result_count\": Within each\n// pair the chunk with the lower score is the candidate for removal; ties are\n// broken by content length (longer wins).\nfunc removePartialOverlaps(ctx context.Context, results []*types.SearchResult) []*types.SearchResult {\n\tconst (\n\t\toverlapThreshold    = 0.85\n\t\tmaxOverlapSizeRatio = 3\n\t\t// maxShorterOnlyFraction is the largest share of the shorter token set\n\t\t// that may be missing from the longer set and still count as one fact.\n\t\t// It sits far below the 0.15 residue the overlap coefficient allows, so\n\t\t// boilerplate cannot hide a requirement, a number, or a conclusion.\n\t\tmaxShorterOnlyFraction = 0.02\n\t)\n\n\tif len(results) <= 1 {\n\t\treturn results\n\t}\n\n\ttype normEntry struct {\n\t\tnorm   string\n\t\tresult *types.SearchResult\n\t\ttokens map[string]struct{} // built on first use\n\t}\n\ttokensOf := func(e *normEntry) map[string]struct{} {\n\t\tif e.tokens == nil {\n\t\t\te.tokens = searchutil.TokenizeSimple(e.result.Content)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn e.tokens\n\t}\n\n\tentries := make([]normEntry, 0, len(results))\n\tfor _, r := range results {\n\t\tentries = append(entries, normEntry{\n\t\t\tnorm:   searchutil.NormalizeContent(r.Content),\n\t\t\tresult: r,\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\tremoved := make(map[int]bool)\n\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(entries); i++ {\n\t\tif removed[i] {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor j := i + 1; j < len(entries); j++ {\n\t\t\tif removed[j] {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\ta, b := entries[i], entries[j]\n\n\t\t\tshortIdx, longIdx := i, j\n\t\t\tif len(a.norm) > len(b.norm) {\n\t\t\t\tshortIdx, longIdx = j, i\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tcontained := searchutil.IsContentContained(\n\t\t\t\tentries[shortIdx].norm, entries[longIdx].norm,\n\t\t\t)\n\n\t\t\tif !contained {\n\t\t\t\tshortTokens, longTokens := tokensOf(&entries[shortIdx]), tokensOf(&entries[longIdx])\n\t\t\t\tsmall, large := min(len(shortTokens), len(longTokens)), max(len(shortTokens), len(longTokens))\n\t\t\t\tif small*maxOverlapSizeRatio < large ||\n\t\t\t\t\tsearchutil.TokenOverlapRatio(shortTokens, longTokens) < overlapThreshold {\n\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t// Drop only when the longer chunk actually carries the shorter\n\t\t\t\t// one's tokens. A pair where each side has its own tokens is kept.\n\t\t\t\tif shorterOnlyFraction(shortTokens, longTokens) > maxShorterOnlyFraction {\n\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tvictim := shortIdx\n\t\t\tif entries[shortIdx].result.Score > entries[longIdx].result.Score {\n\t\t\t\tvictim = longIdx\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tremoved[victim] = true\n\n\t\t\tkeptIdx := i\n\t\t\tif victim == i {\n\t\t\t\tkeptIdx = j\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tsearchutil.InheritImageEvidence(entries[keptIdx].result, entries[victim].result)\n\t\t\tpipelineInfo(ctx, \"Merge\", \"partial_overlap_drop\", map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\t\"kept_id\":    entries[keptIdx].result.ID,\n\t\t\t\t\"dropped_id\": entries[victim].result.ID,\n\t\t\t\t\"contained\":  contained,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tout := make([]*types.SearchResult, 0, len(results)-len(removed))\n\tfor i, e := range entries {\n\t\tif !removed[i] {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, e.result)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// shorterOnlyFraction is the share of short's tokens that do not appear in long.\n// An empty short set is not evidence that long carries it.\nfunc shorterOnlyFraction(short, long map[string]struct{}) float64 {\n\tif len(short) == 0 {\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tonly := 0\n\tfor tok := range short {\n\t\tif _, ok := long[tok]; !ok {\n\t\t\tonly++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn float64(only) / float64(len(short))\n}\n\nfunc logSearchScoreSample(ctx context.Context, action string, results []*types.SearchResult) {\n\tconst maxLogRows = 8\n\tlimit := min(maxLogRows, len(results))\n\tfor i := 0; i < limit; i++ {\n\t\tr := results[i]\n\t\tpipelineInfo(ctx, \"Search\", action, map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"index\":      i,\n\t\t\t\"chunk_id\":   r.ID,\n\t\t\t\"score\":      fmt.Sprintf(\"%.4f\", r.Score),\n\t\t\t\"match_type\": r.MatchType,\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tif len(results) > limit {\n\t\tpipelineInfo(ctx, \"Search\", action+\"_summary\", map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"total\":     len(results),\n\t\t\t\"logged\":    limit,\n\t\t\t\"truncated\": len(results) - limit,\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\n// targetReportsEmbedFailure reports whether an embedding failure for a KB should\n// be recorded as a retrieval error. It is asserted rather than added to\n// interfaces.KnowledgeBaseService so adapters and test doubles that only serve\n// text queries keep compiling.\ntype imageQueryEmbedder interface {\n\tGetQueryImageEmbedding(ctx context.Context, kbID string, img []byte) ([]float32, error)\n}\n\n// queryVector embeds the query for vector recall. A query image takes the\n// image vector space the index stored image_vector chunks in; text otherwise.\n// An image the model cannot embed is an error, never a silent text fallback:\n// the caller asked to match a picture, and a text query answers something else.\nfunc (p *PluginSearch) queryVector(\n\tctx context.Context, kbID, queryText string, queryImage []byte,\n) ([]float32, error) {\n\tif len(queryImage) == 0 {\n\t\treturn p.knowledgeBaseService.GetQueryEmbedding(ctx, kbID, queryText)\n\t}\n\timageEmbedder, ok := p.knowledgeBaseService.(imageQueryEmbedder)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"this deployment cannot embed a query image\")\n\t}\n\treturn imageEmbedder.GetQueryImageEmbedding(ctx, kbID, queryImage)\n}\n\n// searchByTargets performs KB searches using pre-computed SearchTargets.\n// Targets sharing the same model name, endpoint and configured vector dimension\n// are grouped even across model IDs. Each group computes one query embedding\n// and combines all full-KB targets into a single retrieval call, reducing both\n// embedding API calls and DB round-trips.\nfunc (p *PluginSearch) searchByTargets(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tchatManage *types.ChatManage,\n) ([]*types.SearchResult, error) {\n\tif len(chatManage.SearchTargets) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\n\tqueryText := strings.TrimSpace(chatManage.RewriteQuery)\n\n\t// Batch-fetch KB records to determine embedding model grouping.\n\t// On failure, all targets fall into an empty-key group and HybridSearch\n\t// computes the embedding per-KB (graceful degradation).\n\tkbIDs := make([]string, 0, len(chatManage.SearchTargets))\n\tfor _, t := range chatManage.SearchTargets {\n\t\tkbIDs = append(kbIDs, t.KnowledgeBaseID)\n\t}\n\tvar kbList []*types.KnowledgeBase\n\tkbMap := make(map[string]*types.KnowledgeBase)\n\tif kbs, err := p.knowledgeBaseService.GetKnowledgeBasesByIDsOnly(ctx, kbIDs); err == nil {\n\t\tkbList = kbs\n\t\tfor _, kb := range kbs {\n\t\t\tif kb != nil {\n\t\t\t\tkbMap[kb.ID] = kb\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t} else {\n\t\tpipelineWarn(ctx, \"Search\", \"batch_kb_fetch_error\", map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"error\": err.Error(),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\t// Resolve actual model identities (name + endpoint + configured dimension)\n\t// so that cross-tenant KBs backed by the same vector space share one\n\t// embedding computation.\n\tmodelKeyMap := p.knowledgeBaseService.ResolveEmbeddingModelKeys(ctx, kbList)\n\n\tgroups := make(map[string][]*types.SearchTarget)\n\tfor _, t := range chatManage.SearchTargets {\n\t\tkey := modelKeyMap[t.KnowledgeBaseID] // empty string if unresolved\n\t\tgroups[key] = append(groups[key], t)\n\t}\n\n\tpipelineInfo(ctx, \"Search\", \"embedding_groups\", map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\"total_targets\": len(chatManage.SearchTargets),\n\t\t\"unique_models\": len(groups),\n\t})\n\n\tvar wg sync.WaitGroup\n\tvar mu sync.Mutex\n\tvar results []*types.SearchResult\n\tvar firstErr error\n\tvar errOnce sync.Once\n\trecordError := func(err error) {\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\terrOnce.Do(func() { firstErr = err })\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tfor modelKey, targets := range groups {\n\t\twg.Add(1)\n\t\tgo func(modelKey string, targets []*types.SearchTarget) {\n\t\t\tdefer wg.Done()\n\n\t\t\t// An image query needs the image vector space; no text embedding can\n\t\t\t// stand in for it. When the model key is unresolved the group cannot\n\t\t\t// share one embedding call, so embed per target rather than letting\n\t\t\t// HybridSearch run with QueryText alone.\n\t\t\tif len(chatManage.QueryImage) > 0 && modelKey == \"\" && !chatManage.DisableVectorMatch {\n\t\t\t\tvar innerWg sync.WaitGroup\n\t\t\t\tfor _, target := range targets {\n\t\t\t\t\tinnerWg.Add(1)\n\t\t\t\t\tgo func(t *types.SearchTarget) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tdefer innerWg.Done()\n\t\t\t\t\t\temb, err := p.queryVector(ctx, t.KnowledgeBaseID, queryText, chatManage.QueryImage)\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\trecordError(fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"knowledge base %s cannot embed the query image: %w\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tt.KnowledgeBaseID, err,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t))\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\trecordError(p.searchSingleTarget(\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tctx, chatManage, t, queryText, emb, false, &mu, &results,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t))\n\t\t\t\t\t}(target)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tinnerWg.Wait()\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// Compute embedding once for this model group. When a text query's\n\t\t\t// embedding fails, retain only targets that have a real keyword index;\n\t\t\t// vector-only targets must propagate the failure instead of looking\n\t\t\t// like empty recall. An image query never degrades to text: the\n\t\t\t// picture did not participate in a keyword search.\n\t\t\tvar queryEmbedding []float32\n\t\t\tdisableVector := chatManage.DisableVectorMatch\n\t\t\tsearchableTargets := targets\n\t\t\tif modelKey != \"\" && !disableVector {\n\t\t\t\temb, err := p.queryVector(ctx, targets[0].KnowledgeBaseID, queryText, chatManage.QueryImage)\n\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tif len(chatManage.QueryImage) > 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tfor _, target := range targets err,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t))\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\tpipelineWarn(ctx, \"Search\", \"group_image_embed_failed\", map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"model_key\":      modelKey,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"kb_id\":          targets[0].KnowledgeBaseID,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"error\":          err.Error(),\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\"failed_targets\": len(targets),\n\t\t\t\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\tsearchableTargets = make([]*types.SearchTarget, 0, len(targets))\n\t\t\t\t\tfor _, target := range targets {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tkb := kbMap[target.KnowledgeBaseID]\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif !targetReportsEmbedFailure(kb) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tsearchableTargets = append(searchableTargets, target)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\trecordError(fmt.Errorf(\"knowledge base %s has no keyword fallback: %w\", target.KnowledgeBaseID,       "content": "package service\n\nimport (\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\n\t\"github.com/Tencent/WeKnora/internal/application/service/retriever\"\n\tapperrors \"github.com/Tencent/WeKnora/internal/errors\"\n\t\"github.com/Tencent/WeKnora/internal/logger\"\n\t\"github.com/Tencent/WeKnora/internal/models/embedding\"\n\t\"github.com/Tencent/WeKnora/internal/models/imageprep\"\n\t\"github.com/Tencent/WeKnora/internal/tracing/langfuse\"\n\t\"github.com/Tencent/WeKnora/internal/types\"\n\tsecutils \"github.com/Tencent/WeKnora/internal/utils\"\n)\n\n// maxRetrievalPoolSize bounds every retrieval depth derived from MatchCount:\n// the over-retrieval pool below and the doubling TopK of the FAQ iterative\n// path. Without it a caller-supplied MatchCount scales the vector-store query\n// depth without limit.\nconst maxRetrievalPoolSize = 500\n\n// GetQueryEmbedding computes the query embedding using the embedding model\n// associated with the given knowledge base. Callers can pre-compute and reuse\n// the result across multiple KBs that share the same embedding model and\n// configured vector dimension to avoid redundant embedding API calls.\nfunc (s *knowledgeBaseService) GetQueryEmbedding(ctx context.Context, kbID string, queryText string) ([]float32, error) {\n\tkb, err := s.repo.GetKnowledgeBaseByID(ctx, kbID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tcurrentTenantID := types.MustTenantIDFromContext(ctx)\n\tvar embeddingModel embedding.Embedder\n\n\tif kb.TenantID != currentTenantID {\n\t\tembeddingModel, err = s.modelService.GetEmbeddingModelForTenant(ctx, kb.EmbeddingModelID, kb.TenantID)\n\t} else {\n\t\tembeddingModel, err = s.modelService.GetEmbeddingModel(ctx, kb.EmbeddingModelID)\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlogger.Errorf(ctx, \"GetQueryEmbedding: failed to get embedding model %s: %v\", kb.EmbeddingModelID, err)\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tvector, err := embeddingModel.Embed(types.WithEmbedQuery(ctx), queryText)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif err := validateQueryEmbeddingDimension(embeddingModel, len(vector)); err != nil {\n\t\tlogger.Errorf(ctx, \"GetQueryEmbedding: %v\", err)\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn vector, nil\n}\n\n// GetQueryImageEmbedding computes the query embedding for an image using the\n// same multimodal model path the index used when it stored image_vector chunks,\n// so a query image is comparable with them. It returns an error when the KB's\n// embedding model has no image side: silently falling back to text recall would\n// answer a different question than the one asked.\nfunc (s *knowledgeBaseService) GetQueryImageEmbedding(\n\tctx context.Context, kbID string, img []byte,\n) ([]float32, error) {\n\tif len(img) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"query image is empty\")\n\t}\n\tkb, err := s.repo.GetKnowledgeBaseByID(ctx, kbID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tvar embeddingModel embedding.Embedder\n\tif kb.TenantID != types.MustTenantIDFromContext(ctx) {\n\t\tembeddingModel, err = s.modelService.GetEmbeddingModelForTenant(ctx, kb.EmbeddingModelID, kb.TenantID)\n\t} else {\n\t\tembeddingModel, err = s.modelService.GetEmbeddingModel(ctx, kb.EmbeddingModelID)\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlogger.Errorf(ctx, \"GetQueryImageEmbedding: failed to get embedding model %s: %v\", kb.EmbeddingModelID, err)\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\timageModel, ok := embedding.AsImageEmbedder(embeddingModel)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\t// A KB indexed without images has no image_vector rows to match; a\n\t\t// text query is the only recall it supports.\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"embedding model %s cannot embed images; enable image vectors for this knowledge base or search with text\",\n\t\t\tembeddingModel.GetModelName(),\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\tprepared, err := imageprep.Prepare(img, imageModel.ImageLimits())\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"query image not embeddable: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tvectors, err := imageModel.BatchEmbedImages(types.WithEmbedQuery(ctx), []embedding.Image{prepared})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif len(vectors) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"embedding model returned no vector for the query image\")\n\t}\n\tif err := validateQueryEmbeddingDimension(embeddingModel, len(vectors[0])); err != nil {\n\t\tlogger.Errorf(ctx, \"GetQueryImageEmbedding: %v\", err)\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn vectors[0], nil\n}\n\n// validateQueryEmbeddingDimension catches provider/model configuration drift\n// before a malformed query reaches the vector store. make(map[string]*types.Knowledge)\n\tfor _, chunk := range chunks {\n\t\tknowledge := knowledgeMap[chunk.KnowledgeID]\n\t\tif knowledge == nil || knowledge.ParseStatus == types.ParseStatusCancelled {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tselected = append(selected, chunk)\n\t\tselectedKnowledge[knowledge.ID] = knowledge\n\t\tif len(selected) == primaryLimit {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif len(selected) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tindex := s.buildChunkIndex(selected)\n\n\t// Batch fetch chunks (include shared KB chunks)\n\tlogger.Infof(ctx, \"Fetching chunk data for %d IDs\", len(index.chunkIDs))\n\tallChunks, err := s.listChunksByIDWithShared(ctx, tenantID, index.chunkIDs)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlogger.ErrorWithFields(ctx, err, map[string]interface{}{\n\t\t\t\"tenant_id\": tenantID,\n\t\t\t\"chunk_ids\": index.chunkIDs,\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tlogger.Infof(ctx, \"Chunk data fetched successfully, count: %d\", len(allChunks))\n\n\t// Build chunk map and collect enrichment IDs (parent, related, nearby)\n\tchunkMap := make(map[string]*types.Chunk, len(allChunks))\n\tfor _, chunk := range allChunks {\n\t\tchunkMap[chunk.ID] = chunk\n\t}\n\n\tif !skipEnrichment {\n\t\tadditionalChunkIDs := s.collectEnrichmentChunkIDs(ctx, allChunks, index)\n\t\tif len(additionalChunkIDs) > 0 {\n\t\t\tlogger.Infof(ctx, \"Fetching %d additional chunks\", len(additionalChunkIDs))\n\t\t\tadditionalChunks, err := s.listChunksByIDWithShared(ctx, tenantID, additionalChunkIDs)\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tlogger.Warnf(ctx, \"Failed to fetch some additional chunks: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tfor _, chunk := range additionalChunks {\n\t\t\t\t\tchunkMap[chunk.ID] = chunk\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t// Second round: only needed when image chunks are among primary\n\t\t\t\t// results (image → text resolved above, now text → parent_text).\n\t\t\t\t// For normal text-only results this is a no-op.\n\t\t\t\tif s.hasImageChunks(allChunks) {\n\t\t\t\t\tparentIDs := s.collectParentChunkIDs(additionalChunks, index)\n\t\t\t\t\tif len(parentIDs) > 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tlogger.Infof(ctx, \"Fetching %d second-level parent chunks\", len(parentIDs))\n\t\t\t\t\t\tparentChunks, err := s.listChunksByIDWithShared(ctx, tenantID, parentIDs)\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlogger.Warnf(ctx, \"Failed to fetch second-level parent chunks: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tfor _, chunk := range parentChunks {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tchunkMap[chunk.ID] = chunk\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Build final search results\n\tsearchResults := s.assembleSearchResults(ctx, selected, chunkMap, selectedKnowledge, index, skipEnrichment)\n\n\t// Results can come from org-shared KBs owned by another workspace; the\n\t// chunks above were already permission checked, so look up their image\n\t// children without the caller-tenant filter (#3342).\n\tsearchutil.EnrichSearchResultsImageInfoOnly(ctx, s.chunkRepo, searchResults)\n\n\tlogger.Infof(ctx, \"Search results processed, total: %d\", len(searchResults))\n\treturn searchResults, nil\n}\n\n// chunkIndex holds pre-computed lookup structures for processing search results.\ntype chunkIndex struct {\n\tchunkIDs        []string\n\tscores          map[string]float64\n\tvectorScores    map[string]float64\n\tmatchTypes      map[string]types.MatchType\n\tmatchedContents map[string]string\n\tprocessedIDs    map[string]bool // tracks all IDs (chunk + enrichment) to avoid duplicates\n}\n\n// buildChunkIndex collects chunk IDs and builds score/matchType maps\n// from the raw retrieval results.\nfunc (s *knowledgeBaseService) buildChunkIndex(chunks []*types.IndexWithScore) *chunkIndex {\n\tidx := &chunkIndex{\n\t\tscores:          make(map[string]float64, len(chunks)),\n\t\tvectorScores:    make(map[string]float64, len(chunks)),\n\t\tmatchTypes:      make(map[string]types.MatchType, len(chunks)),\n\t\tmatchedContents: make(map[string]string, len(chunks)),\n\t\tprocessedIDs:    make(map[string]bool, len(chunks)*2),\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, chunk := range chunks {\n\t\tidx.chunkIDs = append(idx.chunkIDs, chunk.ChunkID)\n\t\tidx.scores[chunk.ChunkID] = chunk.Score\n\t\tidx.vectorScores[chunk.ChunkID] = chunk.VectorScore\n\t\tidx.matchTypes[chunk.ChunkID] = chunk.MatchType\n\t\tidx.matchedContents[chunk.ChunkID] = chunk.Content\n\t}\n\treturn idx\n}\n\n// collectEnrichmentChunkIDs gathers IDs for parent, related, and nearby chunks\n// that should be fetched to enrich the search results.\nfunc (s *knowledgeBaseService) collectEnrichmentChunkIDs(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tallChunks []*types.Chunk,\n\tidx *chunkIndex,\n) []string {\n\t// Mark all primary chunks as processed\n\tfor _, chunk := range allChunks {\n\t\tidx.processedIDs[chunk.ID] = true\n\t}\n\n\tvar additionalIDs []string\n\n\tfor _, chunk := range allChunks {\n\t\t// Collect parent chunks\n\t\tif chunk.ParentChunkID != \"\" && !idx.processedIDs[chunk.ParentChunkID] {\n\t\t\tadditionalIDs = append(additionalIDs, chunk.ParentChunkID)\n\t\t\tidx.processedIDs[chunk.ParentChunkID] = true\n\t\t\tidx.scores[chunk.ParentChunkID] = idx.scores[chunk.ID]\n\t\t\tidx.matchTypes[chunk.ParentChunkID] = types.MatchTypeParentChunk\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Collect related chunks\n\t\trelationChunkIDs := s.collectRelatedChunkIDs(chunk, idx.processedIDs)\n\t\tfor _, chunkID := range relationChunkIDs {\n\t\t\tadditionalIDs = append(additionalIDs, chunkID)\n\t\t\tidx.matchTypes[chunkID] = types.MatchTypeRelationChunk\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Add nearby chunks (prev and next) for text chunks\n\t\tif slices.Contains([]string{types.ChunkTypeText}, chunk.ChunkType) {\n\t\t\tif chunk.NextChunkID != \"\" && !idx.processedIDs[chunk.NextChunkID] {\n\t\t\t\tadditionalIDs = append(additionalIDs, chunk.NextChunkID)\n\t\t\t\tidx.processedIDs[chunk.NextChunkID] = true\n\t\t\t\tidx.matchTypes[chunk.NextChunkID] = types.MatchTypeNearByChunk\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif chunk.PreChunkID != \"\" && !idx.processedIDs[chunk.PreChunkID] {\n\t\t\t\tadditionalIDs = append(additionalIDs, chunk.PreChunkID)\n\t\t\t\tidx.processedIDs[chunk.PreChunkID] = true\n\t\t\t\tidx.matchTypes[chunk.PreChunkID] = types.MatchTypeNearByChunk\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn additionalIDs\n}\n\n// collectParentChunkIDs returns unprocessed parent IDs from the given chunks.\n// Unlike collectEnrichmentChunkIDs, this only resolves parent links without\n// expanding nearby or related chunks, making it suitable for second-round\n// parent chain resolution (e.g., text → parent_text after image → text).\nfunc (s *knowledgeBaseService) collectParentChunkIDs(\n\tchunks []*types.Chunk,\n\tidx *chunkIndex,\n) []string {\n\tvar ids []string\n\tfor _, chunk := range chunks {\n\t\tif chunk.ParentChunkID != \"\" && !idx.processedIDs[chunk.ParentChunkID] {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, chunk.ParentChunkID)\n\t\t\tidx.processedIDs[chunk.ParentChunkID] = true\n\t\t\tidx.scores[chunk.ParentChunkID] = idx.scores[chunk.ID]\n\t\t\tidx.matchTypes[chunk.ParentChunkID] = types.MatchTypeParentChunk\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn ids\n}\n\n// hasImageChunks returns true if any chunk is one of the image child types.\nfunc (s *knowledgeBaseService) hasImageChunks(chunks []*types.Chunk) bool {\n\tfor _, c := range chunks {\n\t\tif types.IsImageChildChunkType(c.ChunkType) {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// assembleSearchResults builds the final []*types.SearchResult from chunk data and knowledge data.\n// Primary results (from input chunks) are added first in order, then enrichment results.\nfunc (s *knowledgeBaseService) assembleSearchResults(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tinputChunks []*types.IndexWithScore,\n\tchunkMap map[string]*types.Chunk,\n\tknowledgeMap map[string]*types.Knowledge,\n\tidx *chunkIndex,\n\tskipEnrichment bool,\n) []*types.SearchResult {\n\tvar searchResults []*types.SearchResult\n\taddedChunkIDs := make(map[string]bool)\n\tconst maxInvalidChunkLog = 8\n\tinvalidChunkCnt := 0\n\tinvalidChunkSamples := make([]string, 0, maxInvalidChunkLog)\n\n\t// First pass: Add results in the original order from input chunks\n\tfor _, inputChunk := range inputChunks {\n\t\tchunk, exists := chunkMap[inputChunk.ChunkID]\n\t\tif !exists {\n\t\t\tlogger.Debugf(ctx, \"Chunk not found in chunkMap: %s\", inputChunk.ChunkID)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !s.isSearchableChunk(chunk) {\n\t\t\tinvalidChunkCnt++\n\t\t\tif len(invalidChunkSamples) < maxInvalidChunkLog {\n\t\t\t\tinvalidChunkSamples = append(invalidChunkSamples, chunk.ID+\":\"+chunk.ChunkType)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif addedChunkIDs[chunk.ID] {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tscore := idx.scores[chunk.ID]\n\t\tif knowledge, ok := knowledgeMap[chunk.KnowledgeID]; ok {\n\t\t\tmatchType := idx.matchTypes[chunk.ID]\n\t\t\tmatchedContent := idx.matchedContents[chunk.ID]\n\t\t\tresult := s.buildSearchResult(chunk, knowledge, score, matchType, matchedContent)\n\t\t\tresult.VectorScore = idx.vectorScores[chunk.ID]\n\t\t\tsearchutil.CaptureImageEvidence(result)\n\t\t\tsearchResults = append(searchResults, result)\n\t\t\taddedChunkIDs[chunk.ID] = true\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tlogger.Warnf(ctx, \"Knowledge not found for chunk: %s, knowledge_id: %s\", chunk.ID, chunk.KnowledgeID)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif invalidChunkCnt > 0 {\n\t\tlogger.Debugf(ctx,\n\t\t\t\"Skip non-searchable chunks in search results: total=%d sampled=%d samples=%v\",\n\t\t\tinvalidChunkCnt, len(invalidChunkSamples), invalidChunkSamples,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\t// Second pass: Add enrichment chunks (parent, nearby, relation)\n\tif !skipEnrichment {\n\t\tfor chunkID, chunk := range chunkMap {\n\t\t\tif addedChunkIDs[chunkID] || !s.isSearchableChunk(chunk) {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tscore, hasScore := idx.scores[chunkID]\n\t\t\tif !hasScore || score <= 0 {\n\t\t\t\tscore = 0.0\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif knowledge, ok := knowledgeMap[chunk.KnowledgeID]; ok {\n\t\t\t\tmatchType := types.MatchTypeParentChunk\n\t\t\t\tif specificType, exists := idx.matchTypes[chunkID]; exists {\n\t\t\t\t\tmatchType = specificType\n\t\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t\tlogger.Warnf(ctx, \"Unkonwn match type for chunk: %s\", chunkID)\n\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tmatchedContent := idx.matchedContents[chunkID]\n\t\t\t\tsearchResults = append(searchResults, s.buildSearchResult(chunk, knowledge, score, matchType, matchedContent))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tlogSearchResultChunkTypes(ctx, searchResults)\n\treturn searchResults\n}\n\n// logSearchResultChunkTypes records how many returned hits came from each\n// chunk type. It exists to answer one question with data: how often does the\n// document-level summary chunk actually surface, compared with text chunks?\n// If \"summary\" stays near zero in production, indexing it can be dropped.\nfunc logSearchResultChunkTypes(ctx context.Context, results []*types.SearchResult) {\n\tif len(results) == 0 {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tcounts := make(map[string]int, 4)\n\tfor _, r := range results {\n\t\tif r == nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tkey := r.ChunkType\n\t\tif key == \"\" {\n\t\t\tkey = string(types.ChunkTypeText)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcounts[key]++\n\t}\n\tlogger.GetLogger(ctx).WithField(\"chunk_type_counts\", counts).\n\t\tWithField(\"total\", len(results)).\n\t\tInfof(\"search results by chunk type\")\n}\n\n// collectRelatedChunkIDs extracts related chunk IDs from a chunk.\nfunc (s *knowledgeBaseService) collectRelatedChunkIDs(chunk *types.Chunk, processedIDs map[string]bool) []string {\n\tvar relatedIDs []string\n\tif len(chunk.RelationChunks) > 0 {\n\t\tvar relations []string\n\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(chunk.RelationChunks, &relations); err == nil {\n\t\t\tfor _, id := range relations {\n\t\t\t\tif !processedIDs[id] {\n\t\t\t\t\trelatedIDs = append(relatedIDs, id)\n\t\t\t\t\tprocessedIDs[id] = true\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn relatedIDs\n}\n\n// buildSearchResult creates a search result from chunk and knowledge.\nfunc (s *knowledgeBaseService) buildSearchResult(chunk *types.Chunk,\n\tknowledge *types.Knowledge,\n\tscore float64,\n\tmatchType types.MatchType,\n\tmatchedContent string,\n) *types.SearchResult {\n\treturn &types.SearchResult{\n\t\tID:                      chunk.ID,\n\t\tContent:                 chunk.Content,\n\t\tContentRevision:         chunk.ContentRevision,\n\t\tKnowledgeID:             chunk.KnowledgeID,\n\t\tChunkIndex:              chunk.ChunkIndex,\n\t\tKnowledgeTitle:          knowledge.Title,\n\t\tStartAt:                 chunk.StartAt,\n\t\tEndAt:                   chunk.EndAt,\n\t\tSeq:                     chunk.ChunkIndex,\n\t\tScore:                   score,\n\t\tMatchType:               matchType,\n\t\tMetadata:                knowledge.GetMetadata(),\n\t\tChunkType:               string(chunk.ChunkType),\n\t\tParentChunkID:           chunk.ParentChunkID,\n\t\tImageInfo:               chunk.ImageInfo,\n\t\tKnowledgeFilename:       knowledge.FileName,\n\t\tKnowledgeSource:         knowledge.Source,\n\t\tKnowledgeChannel:        knowledge.Channel,\n\t\tKnowledgeDescription:    knowledge.Description,\n\t\tKnowledgeCustomMetadata: knowledge.CustomMetadataText(),\n\t\tChunkMetadata:           chunk.Metadata,\n\t\tContextHeader:           chunk.ContextHeader,\n\t\tMatchedContent:          matchedContent,\n\t\tKnowledgeBaseID:         knowledge.KnowledgeBaseID,\n\t\tSourceLocators:          chunk.SourceLocators,\n\t}\n}\n\n// isSearchableChunk checks if a chunk type should be included in search results.\nfunc (s *knowledgeBaseService) isSearchableChunk(chunk *types.Chunk) bool {\n\tif chunk == nil || !chunk.IsEnabled {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\t// An edit is persisted before its retrieval artifacts are synchronized.\n\t// Do not hydrate stale vector hits while that synchronization is pending or\n\t// failed. Empty is accepted for legacy rows created before index_status.\n\tif chunk.IndexStatus == \"processing\" || chunk.IndexStatus == \"failed\" {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn slices.Contains([]types.ChunkType{\n\t\ttypes.ChunkTypeText, types.ChunkTypeSummary,\n\t\ttypes.ChunkTypeTableColumn, types.ChunkTypeTableSummary,\n\t\ttypes.ChunkTypeFAQ,\n\t\ttypes.ChunkTypeImageOCR, types.ChunkTypeImageCaption, types.ChunkTypeImageVector,\n\t}, chunk.ChunkType)\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-weknora/README_CN.md",
      "content": "# @wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora\n\n[English](./README.md) | 简体中文\n\n[npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora)\n\n一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）插件，让 harness 里的 Agent 直接用上\n[WeKnora](https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora) 知识库：混合检索、按文档通读、以及 WeKnora 自己带引用的成稿答案。\n\ndsh 本身没有任何检索、向量或知识库能力——它的 `grep`、`glob` 只看工作区文件，`web_search` 只看互联网。这个插件把缺的这一\n块换成你自己的文档。\n\n## 安装\n\n```sh\n# 从 npm 安装（推荐：装到的是构建产物，用户无需授权执行构建脚本）\ndsh plugin --profile web add @wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora\n\n# 或者从本仓库的检出目录安装\ndsh plugin --profile web add ./packages/dsh-weknora\n```\n\n然后把它指向你的部署。插件自带的配置层会读环境变量，所以最快的起步方式是：\n\n```sh\nexport WEKNORA_BASE_URL=https://weknora.example.com   # 或 http://localhost:8080\nexport WEKNORA_API_KEY=sk-...                          # 需要 `retrieve` 能力（用 ask 还需要 `chat`）\nexport WEKNORA_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_IDS=kb-123,kb-456        # 可选的默认知识库范围\nexport WEKNORA_RESOURCE_URLS=public                    # 默认；改成 `handle` 则保留内部文件引用\ndsh web\n```\n\n超出这个范围的配置，在 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`）里覆盖这一行：\n\n```yaml\n- id: weknora\n  config:\n    baseUrl: https://weknora.example.com\n    apiKey: !!js process.env.WEKNORA_API_KEY\n    knowledgeBaseIds:\n      - kb-product-docs\n    agentId: ''            # 填 WeKnora 自定义 Agent id，`weknora_ask` 就走 ReAct 流水线\n    maxResults: 8\n    maxChunkChars: 1200\n    requestTimeoutMs: 30000\n    chatTimeoutMs: 300000\n    resourceUrls: handle   # 默认是 `public`，引用里的图片给可直接加载的直链；`handle` 保留内部引用\n    toolPrefix: weknora    # 重命名工具，例如同时挂两个部署时\n    tools:\n      listKnowledgeBases: true\n      search: true\n      readDocument: true\n      ask: true\n```\n\npatch 是整块替换该行的 `config`，所以要保留的字段需要一并写出。配置不合法会在插件加载阶段失败，并逐条列出问题，而不是等到\n模型第一次调用工具时才报错。\n\n同时挂两个部署，就是两行加两个前缀：\n\n```yaml\n- insert:\n    - id: weknora-internal\n      name: \"@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora\"\n      config: { baseUrl: https://kb.internal.example.com, toolPrefix: internal_kb }\n    - id: weknora-public\n      name: \"@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh-weknora\"\n      config: { baseUrl: https://kb.public.example.com, toolPrefix: public_kb }\n```\n\n## 工具\n\n| 工具 | WeKnora 接口 | 模型拿到什么 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `weknora_list_knowledge_bases` | `GET /knowledge-bases` | 知识库名称与 id，用于说明有哪些库，或为后续检索缩小范围 |\n| `weknora_search` | `POST /knowledge-search` + `GET /knowledge/search` | 原文片段与排序，每条带 `knowledge_id`、得分、分块序号，外加查询点名的文档 |\n| `weknora_read_document` | `GET /chunks/:knowledge_id` + `GET /knowledge/:id` | 单个文档按序拼回的正文，开头给出标题与摘要，支持翻页 |\n| `weknora_ask` | `POST /sessions` + `POST /knowledge-chat/:id` 或 `POST /agent-chat/:id` | WeKnora 自己的答案、引用、服务端用过的工具，以及可续聊的 `session_id` |\n\n`weknora_search` 是主力：它把原文交给 Agent 自己推理，Agent 的结论因此是可审计的。它在同一次调用里同时匹配片段内容和\n文档名，因为模型常常分不清自己要找的是「哪里讲了这件事」还是「那份叫 X 的文档在哪」。当查询读起来像个标题时，结果里会额外\n列出被点名的文档——这样即便某份文档的正文用词与标题完全不同，也依然够得着。\n\n范围不需要配置。没有指定知识库的调用，检索接口会直接拒绝，RAG 接口则会在什么都没检索到的情况下作答，因此当\n`knowledgeBaseIds` 为空时，插件会自己解析出该凭据可见的全部知识库并一并使用；这份清单每个进程只解析一次，且由\n`weknora_search` 与 `weknora_ask` 共用。让模型先去挑反而更糟：知识库的命名往往糟糕到无从选择。\n\n`weknora_ask` 把整个问题委派给 WeKnora。它适合跨多篇文档、需要综合的宽泛问题，也就是自己检索要来回好几轮的场景；它在服务端\n再跑一个模型，所以慢，而且返回的是结论而非支撑结论的证据。配了 `agentId` 时它不会自己填范围：自定义 Agent 会按自己的知识库\n选择模式在服务端解析范围，从这里传 id 反而会把它覆盖掉。\n\n`weknora_read_document` 的存在是因为检索返回的是碎片：一旦某个片段看起来对，Agent 通常还需要它的上下文。每条检索结果都带\n着这次调用需要的 `knowledge_id`；第一页会先给出文档标题和 WeKnora 生成的摘要，长文档不必翻完才知道自己拿到的是什么。\n\n在 [Code Mode](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/tools/README.md) 下，同样的工具\n可以写成 `await tools.weknora_search({ query })`，特别适合多跳检索：一段程序里扇出十个子问题，而不是十次模型往返。\n\n## 权限与数据流\n\n插件只读。它不会写 WeKnora：不入库、不改分块、不删除。四个工具里有三个只需要 `retrieve` 能力的 API Key；`weknora_ask`\n额外需要 `chat`，因为它要创建会话并流式取回答案。\n\nKey 通过 `X-API-Key` 发送。如果用的是平台级 API Key，还需要配 `tenantId`，它会作为 `X-Tenant-ID` 选择工作空间。报错信息\n只包含 HTTP 状态码和 WeKnora 自己给出的原因，不会带上 Key。\n\n片段内容在进入模型前会按 `maxChunkChars` 截断，避免一份超大文档吃掉整个上下文窗口；截断这件事会明确告知模型\n（`truncated: true`），而不是悄悄丢文本。\n\n默认 `resourceUrls: public` 时，WeKnora 会把片段里的 `resource://` 图改写成可直接加载的 http(s) 直链——把这些 Markdown\n图片写进回复，dsh 网页端就会把图画出来。限定知识库的 API Key 拿不到直链（WeKnora 会 403），插件会把这次调用改回\nhandle 模式，之后也一直用 handle。\n\n配置层还会读 `WEKNORA_RESOURCE_URLS`（`public` 或 `handle`）。\n\n## 配置项\n\n| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:8080/api/v1` | 缺少 `/api/v1` 时自动补全 |\n| `apiKey` | 未设置 | `X-API-Key`；不设表示部署无鉴权 |\n| `tenantId` | 未设置 | `X-Tenant-ID`，平台级 Key 必填 |\n| `knowledgeBaseIds` | `[]` | 调用未指定范围时的默认值；留空表示检索该凭据可见的全部知识库 |\n| `agentId` | 未设置 | 让 `weknora_ask` 走 ReAct 流水线 |\n| `maxResults` | `8` | 同时是 `max_results` 与引用条数的上限 |\n| `maxChunkChars` | `1200` | 单个片段的字符预算 |\n| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | 检索与读文档 |\n| `chatTimeoutMs` | `300000` | `weknora_ask`，要等 WeKnora 自己的模型调用 |\n| `resourceUrls` | `public` | `public` 返回可直接加载的文件直链；`handle` 保留内部 `resource://` 引用。限定知识库的 API Key 会自动回退到 `handle`。可用 `WEKNORA_RESOURCE_URLS` 覆盖。 |\n| `toolPrefix` | `weknora` | 工具名前缀，需匹配 `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$` |\n| `tools.*` | 全部 `true` | 少注册几个工具就少占几分 prompt |\n\n## 开发\n\n```sh\nnpm install\nnpm test          # 先构建，再跑单元测试与契约测试\nnpm run typecheck\n```\n\n端到端检查会把这个包装进一个临时 dsh profile，用 mock 的 WeKnora 后端和一个确定性的 OpenAI 兼容模型启动 headless\nprofile，并断言 harness 真的调用了工具、并且答案来自工具返回的内容：\n\n```sh\nnpm run build\nnode test/e2e/run-in-dsh.mjs                        # 首次运行会从 npm 装一个 dsh\nDSH_BIN=/path/to/dsh node test/e2e/run-in-dsh.mjs   # 或者复用已有安装\n```\n\ndsh 的会话持久化需要带 zstd 的 Node（≥ 22.15 或 ≥ 24），并且 `PATH` 上要有 pnpm ≥ 10——`dsh plugin add` 通过 pnpm 装进\nprofile，而它写出的 profile 把设置放在 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里。插件自身只要求 Node ≥ 20.11，两者都不需要。\n\n`test/fixtures/api-contract.json` 记录了本插件发出的每一个 WeKnora 调用。`test/contract.test.mjs` 断言插件仍然只发这些\n调用，`contract/contract_test.go` 断言 WeKnora 真实的 Go 请求/响应类型仍然接受并提供这些字段——任何一侧改名都会在 CI 挂掉，\n而不是在用户的 Agent 里挂掉。\n\n## 兼容性\n\n已针对 dsh `0.1.0-rc.8` 与 WeKnora `0.8.0` 验证。dsh 处于 developer preview 并明确会有破坏性变更；本包因此**没有任何运行\n时依赖**，交给 `ctx.tools.register()` 的只是一个普通对象，不锁定任何 harness 包版本。如果 harness 的工具定义契约发生变化，\n请在本仓库提 issue。\n\n## 许可\n\nMIT，与 WeKnora 和 dsh 一致。\n"
